topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Found that soft, forgotten thing amidst the clutter—dust motes dancing around it, mocking the light. How did it end here? Hands close around what once was cherished, now lost and reclaimed from strangers. This fabric, threadbare and worn, whispers of a time when the world was vast and safe. To find it here, after all these years, tangled in the web of what's no longer needed. It shouldn't stir such a storm, yet here it is, a silent reminder of something broken, something left behind. Not just a bear, but a fragment of the past, intruding on the present with no gentle warning.
